budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Trackers 0 and 1 cooperate to tag runners before extraction. Runners 2 and 3 cooperate to reach either exit, using hiding, shared-trail erasure and decoys with finite charges.
task.natural_termination: Both runners have resolved, each either captured or extracted; mixed outcomes are valid. Otherwise truncate at 64 steps. Capture precedes extraction on the same transition.
task.interaction: Trace manipulation changes opponent information and can erase a teammate's trail; scans compete with limited tag charges. Tagging changes both teams' reward and removes a runner. Teammates share their active positions and charges but do not automatically share every local scent observation.
task.observation_access: Map and resolved status are public. Own-team active positions and charges are shared. Opponents are shown only within native Manhattan vision with brush/hide concealment, close-range or scan exceptions. Scent is local and anonymous; no hidden positions, opponent charges, private actions or full scent field appear in role view.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Public newly captured runner flags, ordered runners 2,3
Public newly extracted runner flags, ordered runners 2,3
Public total runners already captured or extracted

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
